noise.VP_pair: same source,SNR,seed,shape,standard_noise; different learned waveforms allowed

fixed_mode_rx: pre-shared singleton allowed-mode set; a CRC-valid different mode is illegal and scored as header erasure; no TX mode input at RX
adaptive_mode_rx: pre-shared family; decoded legal mode selects ND/NA and receiver; wrong accepted dispatch retained, never repaired using TX truth
header_failure: RGB0.5, latent loss masked, image loss and all resources retained
tx_assumptions: true class known at TX and transmitted through header
selection: minimum complete 1000-source five-SNR three-noise mean training utility; no development selection

extension_rule.criterion: both last full-calibration intervals at 15000->17500->20000 improve utility by >=0.2% for at least one arm; extend its V/P pair together; reassess each 10k using calibration only

budget3060.select_m: minimum full-calibration primary1/4/7 U_image of H6-V/H7-V; tie lower m
budget3060.pure: train exact6120 real coordinates from initialization

policy.calibration_split: even source indices tune, odd validate, registered before codec training
policy.fitting_sources: first2000 source IDs in original train order
policy.gate: cross-noise relative U_image improvement over SNR table >=1% and at least2 actions selected on >=5% of source/SNR keys; otherwise skip predictor
policy.model: ridge, standardized TX-only features, alpha grid[0.1,1,10,100]

repeats.scope: final candidate and direct mechanism controls after first-seed calibration decision

new_test: select500 only after network/protocol/policy freeze; exclude all known communication train/cal/dev/historical holdout image identities; no pretraining-overlap claim

safety.thermal_pause: hardware thermal slowdown on three consecutive 10-update observations; or >=86C on three; safe paired-update checkpoint; no device setting changes
